title: Maude generation provenance (assets/<sha8>.gen.json), maude.gen v1
description: One file per AI take, named by that take's own sha8 (contract S8-asset-sidecars §5.2; skill design:ai-generation). The runtime source is `validateGen` in apps/studio/generation/gen-sidecar.ts — `maude design check --strict` runs it; test/gen-sidecar.test.ts holds this file to the same verdicts. LENIENT: unknown keys are allowed and kept (V2-1.12 R8 does not apply). A file with `v` above 1 is treated as absent by this version, never rewritten. File limit 16 KiB.
